description:
Watch an Amazon product for the user: Apiguru checks it on a schedule
        and tells them when the price or stock changes. Needs the user's
        Apiguru account (sign-in or API key); ask the user first, because the
        checks spend their money on a schedule.

        Cost: creating the watch is free. Each check is billed to the account
        like the matching data call: price or availability 1 request, stock
        (stock_below) 2, stock of every seller (stock_scope="all") about one
        per seller plus one per ten sellers. Automatic checks stop for the day
        at the account's daily limit ($1 unless the user changes it).
        Example: one stock watch every 6 hours = 8 requests a day.

        asin:             ASIN or Amazon product URL.
        alert_type:       price_below | price_above (need threshold, in the
                          marketplace's currency) | price_change | in_stock |
                          out_of_stock | stock_below (threshold = units).
        geo:              marketplace, e.g. US, UK, DE, JP (a URL sets it).
        check_interval_s: 60, 300, 900, 1800, 3600, 10800, 21600 (default,
                          6 hours), 43200 or 86400 seconds.
        stock_scope:      stock_below only: winner (buy-box seller) or all.

        When a watch fires the user gets an email, plus a webhook call or a
        Telegram message if they set one up at https://dash.apiguru.app/tools/alerts.
        Returns the watch with its id (for delete_watch) and requests_per_check.
name: watch_product
title: Watch a product's price or stock (user's account; billed per check)
